panel: kit/panels/general-v1.jsonl rows with panel == knowledge (100 MMLU items, four options each)
parsing: question = prompt text before the first blank line followed by '(A) '; options = the consecutive lines '(<letter>) <text>' of that block, letters A, B, C, D in order; gold = index of the row's answer letter; the trailing generation instruction is not part of the context
continuation: context + ' ' + option text (option text stripped; no letter, no chat template, no special tokens)
boundary: tokenize(context) must be a strict prefix of tokenize(context + ' ' + option); otherwise the item fails (never repaired)
eos: no EOS token is appended or scored; only the option-text tokens after the context boundary are summed
normalisation: sum of option-token log probabilities divided by Python len(option text), Unicode characters, excluding the separator space
tokenizer_source: frozen pinned base tokenizer for every checkpoint (kit/resources/m2/format-validity.json tokenizer_files)
production: vLLM prompt_logprobs (temperature 0, max_tokens 1), one GPU, bf16, eager, seed 0
reference: independent sequential HF bf16 forward with explicit token-by-token log-softmax reduction
validation: per seed's scoring assignment, on the base checkpoint, before any outcome: complete 100x4 coverage, finite likelihoods, selected-choice agreement 100/100; otherwise PENDING (CR stays pending; no endpoint switch)
strict_letter: generated-letter knowledge scores and format failures are diagnostic only
